subject: Film & Cinema
title: Billy Wilder: Comedy with a Razor
description: A 60-second lesson on Billy Wilder: Comedy with a Razor.

hook.text: Billy Wilder could make you laugh and wince in the same scene. That was his gift.

buildup.text: Some Like It Hot, Sunset Boulevard, and The Apartment mixed comedy with bitter truths.

discovery.text: Wilder started as a screenwriter and never lost his ear for razor-sharp dialogue.

twist.text: He fled Nazi Germany in 1933. His mother died in Auschwitz. Comedy was his armor.

climax.text: His films prove that the funniest stories often contain the saddest truths.

punchline.text: Laughter was his way of telling the truth.

quiz.question: What was distinctive about Billy Wilder's filmmaking style?
options: Mixing sharp comedy with bitter, darker truths
